items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He called me... Everybody was Junior [inaudible]. “How ya doin’, Junior?”

ctx.x: He called everybody Junior. “How ya doin’, Junior?” And he had one little sound box, you know. You see all these guy with pedals [inaudible]. He had the usual, right from the rack, you know, Fender piano, and on that a little box and a plug… [blows raspberry] and then he had a way to move. Are you familiar with his move?
